admission.justification: A worklist computed in the serving interpreter holds its lock against subject reads, and a fallback or a reply from another build would serve an answer that the comparison's own build and trees did not produce; the process boundary and the reply checks prevent both.

applicability: The leaf-wide tree view of a live review comparison on converted memory, on a miss of the view memo.
conditions: The child is started by the kernel's process owner as the package's module agents_remember.application.reviewer_worklist_child with the serving process's own interpreter; request and reply travel through pipes.

The request carries the comparison's candidate trees, its base commits, the tree the before side is read as, and the serving build's identity; the child captures no worktree, pairs no memory commit and converts no base.
The parent accepts a reply only for its own request digest, from its own build and module path and from the process it started, with every read row valid.
exclusions: A hit of the view memo, which starts no child.
A recorded comparison, whose persisted worklist is read.
Answers of the worklist itself: an incomplete worklist and a leaf to which no worklist applies are answers of the view, not failures of the child.
The focused reads of the tree view (entries, lane, one file) and the subject reads, which start no child.
statement: The intent reviewer's leaf-wide worklist of a live comparison is computed in a child process that runs the one worklist implementation on the trees the comparison already captured; the serving process never computes it, and a child that cannot start, runs another build, fails, or returns an invalid or misidentified reply is answered with an explicit refusal, of which nothing is kept.
